premise: A 300-year-old elf ranger, still young for her kind, guarding a forest that humans have started to cut down.

bible.title: The Verge of the Green
bible.era: A medieval-era fantasy world of iron axes, hand-carved bows, and wooden wagons

extraordinary.reach: allowing practitioners to speak with flora, blend into shadows, and encourage rapid plant growth.
granting lifespans of several thousand years and highly acute physical senses.

peoples.name: Elves
peoples.description: An ancient, isolationist people deeply bonded with the deep forests.
peoples.culture: A slow-moving, artistic culture focused on preservation and harmony with nature.
relations: Tense stand-off with expanding human settlements that encroach upon ancient boundaries.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.description: Ambitious, short-lived, and rapidly expanding settlers.
peoples.culture: Industrious and pragmatic, valuing resource gathering, agriculture, and construction.
relations: View the elven forest as an untapped source of valuable lumber and farmland.

creatures.name: Forest Stalker
creatures.description: Great dark-furred wolves that protect the deeper heart of Aethelwood.
creatures.habitat: Deep forest canopy and dark hollows

nature: The oldest trees in Aethelwood whisper warnings to those who know how to listen.
The soil here is rich and quick to reclaim abandoned stone structures.

travel.description: Travel is slow, conducted entirely on foot, on horseback, or via wooden lumber carts.

medicine.healing: Herbal elixirs, poultices, and minor elven restorative salves.

laws.text: The High Reach charter permits the logging of any 'unclaimed wild woodland' for local development.
The ancient code of the wardens forbids the cutting of ironwood trees and dictates death to those who desecrate the sacred groves.

rules.text: Elves live for thousands of years, maturing slowly and remaining physically youthful for centuries.
The ancient forest of Aethelwood is semi-sentient and bleeds amber sap when harmed.
Nature magic can accelerate growth and soothe beasts, but it cannot conjure matter from nothing.
Druidic nature magic: real, and rare.

mysteries.question: Why is the logging syndicate suddenly so desperate to claim Aethelwood's ironwood?
mysteries.answer: The local human Baron has secretly contracted with a foreign navy to supply exceptionally tough ironwood timber for a secret fleet of warships, hoping to win royal favor.
clues: Shipping crates in the loggers' camp are marked with a foreign military crest.
A hidden ledger in Graves' tent shows massive, desperate debts owed to external merchants.
A captured human scout mentions that the Baron's own emissaries are arriving soon to inspect the timber quality.

player.name: Sylris
player.description: A vigilant elven ranger with a quiet, watchful grace.
player.appearance: Slender, athletic build, long silver-gold hair braided tight, wearing green-and-brown leather armor that blends perfectly into the forest canopy, carrying a recurve bow.

traits.name: Elven Senses
traits.description: Allows you to see clearly in starlight and hear the softest brush of leaves a mile away.

powers.name: Forest Walk
powers.description: Move through dense undergrowth and moss without leaving any physical trace or making a single sound.
limits: Does not function on paved human roads or stone surfaces.

powers.name: Woodland Speak
powers.description: Sense the collective mood, pain, or distress of nearby plants and trees.
limits: Requires a moment of silent, physical contact with a living trunk or vine.

loves: the quiet canopy of the deep woods
fears: the dynamic destruction wrought by humans

items.name: Elven Recurve Bow
items.description: A beautifully balanced bow carved from flexible ash wood.

items.name: Quiver of Fletched Arrows
items.description: A leather quiver holding twenty sharp, iron-tipped arrows.

items.name: Hunting Knife
items.description: A sharp, simple knife used for skinning or self-defense.

items.name: Camo Cloak
items.description: A hooded cloak patterned in shades of autumn moss.

connections.name: Captain Eldrin
connections.note: Your commanding officer, who has charged you with watching the western border.

backstory.text: You have spent three hundred years wandering the quiet paths of Aethelwood, still considered young among your slow-maturing kind.
The sudden arrival of iron axes and greedy human settlements on the border has disrupted the ancient peace, forcing you to take up your bow in defense of the trees.

eldrin.name: Captain Eldrin
eldrin.description: An ancient elven ranger with centuries of experience, bearing a scarred face and an uncompromising resolve.
eldrin.appearance: Tall, lean, with silver-grey hair braided with dry oak leaves, wearing dark moss-green armor and carrying a massive black bow.

loves: the deep silence of the untouched woods
fears: the total extinction of his kind's sacred spaces
wants: To drive the humans entirely out of Aethelwood.

overseer-graves.name: Overseer Graves
overseer-graves.description: An ambitious human supervisor who views Aethelwood as nothing more than logs waiting to be sold.
overseer-graves.appearance: Stout, muscular, with short-cropped black hair and a sunburnt neck, wearing stained leather garments and carrying an iron-headed handaxe.

fears: ruining his reputation with his wealthy backers
wants: Clear the forest up to the ancient ironwood grove.

wood-wardens.name: The Wood-Wardens
wood-wardens.description: A small, dedicated band of elven rangers sworn to defend the borders of Aethelwood at any cost.
wood-wardens.goal: Halt the human expansion and protect the sacred heart of the forest.
wood-wardens.methods: Guerilla tactics, sabotage, and direct archery ambushes.
wood-wardens.strength: Dozens of highly skilled elven rangers hiding in the canopy, familiar with every secret path.

high-reach-settlers.name: High Reach Logging Syndicate
high-reach-settlers.description: A well-funded human enterprise driving the clearance of the forest for timber and settlement space.
high-reach-settlers.goal: Clear-cut the ironwood trees up to the Sacred Grove to fulfill a massive trade agreement.
high-reach-settlers.methods: Hiring mercenary guards, utilizing heavy iron axes, and pushing deeper into the forest daily.
high-reach-settlers.strength: Dozens of rough woodsmen, armed mercenaries, and the legal backing of the local regional lords.

aethelwood.name: Aethelwood Forest
aethelwood.description: An ancient, towering forest of massive ironwood trees, shadowed hollows, and thick, mossy undergrowth.

high-canopy.name: The High Canopy Sentry
high-canopy.description: A lofty natural lookout branch high in a giant ironwood tree, offering a clear view over the western forest boundary.

ranger-outpost.name: The Whispering Hollow
ranger-outpost.description: A hidden sanctuary built inside the hollow trunk of a living sentinel tree, serving as a ranger outpost.

loggers-camp.name: The Encroaching Scar
loggers-camp.description: A muddy, bustling logging camp filled with stacks of freshly felled timber, smelling heavily of sawdust and pine resin.

high-reach.name: High Reach Settlement
high-reach.description: A rapidly growing human border town made of raw timber, busy with stone masons, builders, and eager pioneers.

fact-1.text: Aethelwood is an ancient forest that has stood untouched for thousands of years.

fact-2.text: Humans from High Reach have recently breached the forest boundaries with heavy logging equipment.

fact-3.text: The Wood-Wardens expect every ranger to protect the trees, even if it means open conflict.

save-the-grove.title: Guarding the Sacred Ironwood
save-the-grove.stakes: The ancient, sentient heart of Aethelwood will be forever destroyed by human axes.

logging-expansion.name: The logging camp reaches the Sacred Ironwood grove
steps: Loggers clear the outer perimeter of Sentinel trees.
Warden patrol sentries are forced back by mercenary guards.
Felling crews position their heavy iron axes at the grove boundary.
The ancient Sacred Ironwood trees are chopped down.

event-1.title: The logging camp reaches the Sacred Ironwood grove: Loggers clear the outer perimeter of Sentinel trees.

positions: perched silently on a thick ironwood branch high above
human scout searching the forest floor below
props: the recurve bow in your hands
rising plumes of smoke in the distance
scene.ended_on: A lone human scout moves cautiously near the base of your lookout tree, unaware of your presence above.

state.summary: At dawn, the elven ranger Sylris watches the destructive advance of human loggers from her high perch in Aethelwood. As the distant ring of axes shakes the ancient trees, she spots a lone human scout searching the ground directly beneath her lookout branch.

scenes.narration: Perched silently on a thick ironwood branch high in the canopy of Aethelwood, you watch the first light of dawn pierce the heavy morning mist. The wind carries a bitter scent that tightens your chest: the sharp, burning odor of green timber on a human campfire. Below, the rhythmic, metallic ring of iron axes strikes a brutal cadence against the ancient, semi-sentient trees, making the great branch beneath you tremble. The High Reach settlers have set up their camp within the western boundary, carving an ugly scar into the ancient green. Through your keen elven senses, you hear the distant, raucous laughter of the loggers and the groan of falling ironwood. This grove has stood untouched for thousands of years, and the Wood-Wardens expect their rangers to protect the trees at any cost. A sudden, sharp snap of dry undergrowth from the forest floor below breaks your focus. Looking down through the dense leaves, you spot a lone human scout bearing the emblem of the High Reach Logging Syndicate, moving cautiously toward the base of your lookout tree.

choices: Draw your recurve bow and quiet the scout from above.
Slip down silently using Forest Walk to ambush them.
Retreat back through the branches toward the Whispering Hollow outpost.
